inspiration: Effects are frame strips with a numbered suffix (e.g. hit sparks ^0 to ^4). A simple convention to copy for our hit and burst effects, with our own art.
Thruster glow comes as a three-frame set (+0, +1, +2). A short loop like this is a cheap engine effect; recreate the timing with our own colours.

Hulls are grouped by culture in their names, so each faction has a family of silhouettes (avgi, gegno, hai, aberrant, heliarch, quarg). Keep the idea that a faction reads by family shape, not the designs.
Backgrounds are layered photo plates (CC0 land plates, painted scenes). Recreate as layered plates with our own painted or generated art and our own tint per zone.
The content lives in plain text data files (factions, ships, outfits, missions, dialogue phrases). A data-first layout for our own content tables is the technique to take, not the text.
Ambient music is sparse drone with a machine or planet mood. Keep the mood brief; compose our own track.
Explosions and hits are short layered WAVs with separate small and large variants (asteroid crunch small, medium, large). Use the size-tier idea with our own sounds.

briefs.label: Culture-family hull set
briefs.why: A faction can be read from silhouette alone when its hulls share one shape language. Name counts suggest this is a deliberate family design (e.g. 35 avgi-prefixed sprites), but the sprites were not viewed.
briefs.keep: Shared shape language per faction; a family of hull variants; faction palette per family
briefs.change: Our own silhouettes and proportions; different palette and ornament; our own faction names
briefs.ref: images/ship/ (prefix groups avgi*, gegno*, hai*, aberrant*); not viewed, names only

briefs.label: Layered hit-spark strip
briefs.why: A short numbered strip reads as impact without heavy compositing.
briefs.keep: Five frames with a fast decay; numbered frame naming
briefs.change: Our own spark shape and colour; a different number of frames; a shard or bloom look
briefs.ref: images/effect/acuit hit^0.png to acuit hit^4.png; names only

briefs.label: Three-frame thruster glow
briefs.why: A tiny loop that makes engines feel alive on a small sprite.
briefs.keep: Three-frame loop; glow grows and fades
briefs.change: Our own colour ramp; a flame or plasma shape; a different loop length

briefs.label: Layered backdrop plates
briefs.why: Several slightly offset plates give depth to a flat space scene.
briefs.keep: Multiple background layers; soft haze over hard shapes
briefs.change: Our own painted or generated plates; our own tint per zone
briefs.ref: images/land/haze0* (CC0 plate, read via copyright file only)

briefs.label: Sparse ambient drone
briefs.why: A low drone supports exploration without fatigue.
briefs.keep: Sparse texture; long repeat; mood per planet or space
briefs.change: Our own composition and instrumentation; a different key per zone
briefs.ref: sounds/ambient/machinery.mp3 (listed only; not played; licence unclear, C)
